brief:
Gaza's Petroleum Authority announced a new gas distribution roster covering 65,140 households in the 8- and 12-kilogram categories, Shehab Wire reported. The authority published a direct verification link allowing residents to check their names, application status, and collection dates.

The announcement comes as Gaza faces ongoing fuel shortages. The new list enables households in both weight categories to track their eligibility and schedule pickup times through the online system.

title: Gaza Petroleum Authority releases new gas eligibility list for 65,140 households
